reviews.text: There should be more veterinarians like this! I can only recommend him! He is always very helpful! He doesn't overdo things just to make more money. In fact! He is also close to the best in price.

I've been taking my cat here for years, and my dog ​​for a year now for vaccinations and checkups. I highly recommend it: we receive professional, empathetic, and attentive care every time. On a five-point scale... ten points!

Farmer, I don't care, vet!
This was our first and last time at this clinic. Before I chose this place, I read the reviews and we went calmly, since there were so many positive opinions.
However, the reality was completely different!!
We took two kittens for annual vaccinations, deworming, and annual check-ups. He didn't even take the kittens out of the carrier, as soon as they stuck their heads out, he gave them the vaccination and the pill and that was it. The 2-kilo kitten was given the same dose (of the dewormer) as the 6-kilo tomcat. After the “Dr” had the examination, he said: 18 thousand. Here I asked him if he didn't even look at the kittens to see if they were healthy? Temperature measurement? Weight measurement? Etc. To which the answer came: “I don't think they're okay”. I'll ask here too: how would he know if he didn't even take them out of the carrier?
I also mentioned that one of the cats had suddenly lost weight, but he didn't care either.
I have never met such a careless, uncaring vet.
If he was careless, he would have at least been nice, but of course he wasn't...

We took our 2 year old French bulldog to be neutered and thanks to the Doctor everything went well. We are still grateful to him for being so calm and professional throughout.
There are few veterinarians as kind-hearted and trustworthy as he is.
The best, most thorough, conscientious doctor I have ever known. I can only recommend him.
A dedicated, great veterinarian! Accurate in his diagnoses and treatments. I can only recommend him to everyone.
I can only recommend him to everyone! Helpful, nice!
